Reputify
Collect and manage reviews via QR, email, and video in one place
Reputify centralizes your customer reviews from Google, Trustpilot, Facebook, Booking.com, and other platforms into a single dashboard. It automatically fetches new reviews, analyzes sentiment, topics, and suspicious activity on EU-based servers, and drafts reply suggestions you can edit and send. Reputify also lets you display a unified Reputify Score and recent reviews on your website via widgets or a WordPress plugin. You can invite customers to leave text or video reviews via email, QR code, or tablet kiosk, with tracking built in. A free plan is available, and no US AI services are involved.

Lucidi
Zero-data-entry home asset tracker with proactive alerts
Lucidi organizes the documents that run your household into a living model of your home. Instead of manually updating spreadsheets or digging through folders, you simply forward your receipts, bills, and warranty documents. The engine connects the dots by linking documents to specific appliances or accounts and proactively alerts you before a warranty expires, a premium increases, or a return window closes. It is a strict push, not pull, system with full provenance, so you can always tap an alert to view the original source file. We built this with a strict zero-training policy (using Anthropic and Voyage AI) to ensure your personal household data is never used to train models.

SketchUp Converter
Convert .skp files to older SketchUp versions in seconds
SketchUp Converter lets you downgrade .skp files so they open in your installed SketchUp version. Upload a model, choose a target version from 2017 to 2025, and download a compatible copy without installing anything. It preserves geometry, groups, components, materials, textures, tags, and dimensions, and reports items not carried over like scenes, custom styles, and text labels. Use it on Mac or Windows, pay per file or monthly, and your files are deleted on schedule for privacy.
